name: rot-dtd-commander
description: RoT DtD Commander: 123 Claude Code commands (the nine RoT MoE lenses as commands among them), 23 skills and 5 agents that carry their own DTD grammar and trust boundary, the creator kit (prompt, meta-prompt, skill, hook, command, subagent, plan, MCP, workflow, task, filetype and dork creators), a guided NPX installer into ~/.claude, the Adiutor, a Stop-hook doctor that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE that produced it, and the Commander-Adiutor, a monitor that hands every failed answer to the session as the ledger closes it; both run by hand unless armed.

scripts.gate: node checker/gate-sync.mjs && npm run build:check && npm run check && node checker/heading-sweep.mjs --check && node checker/frontmatter-sweep.mjs --check && npm run controls && node checker/contract-audit.mjs && bash checker/checker-controls.sh && npm run sweep && npm run controls:ordinals && npm run controls:slop && npm run controls:ceiling && npm run controls:form && npm run controls:args && npm run controls:schematic && npm run controls:workflow && npm run controls:task && npm run controls:record && npm run controls:license && npm run controls:scratch && npm run controls:amplify && npm run sweep:slop && npm run sweep:prose && npm run sweep:tracked && npm run sweep:index && npm run sweep:counts && node checker/release-notes.mjs --versions && node checker/release-notes.mjs --controls
scripts.sweep:slop: node lib/ai-slop.mjs sweep src/commands src/skills src/agents --max 0
scripts.sweep:prose: node lib/ai-slop.mjs README.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs CHANGELOG.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs NOTICE.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs SECURITY.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs PRIVACY.md && node lib/ai-slop.mjs RELEASE.md
